name: MediaOps-Discord-Router
description: Optional hardened companion service for MediaOps that receives Ombi or Seerr webhook notifications and routes media-request lifecycle updates into managed Discord Forum threads. Historical image/path identifiers are retained for upgrade compatibility.

paths.name: Router Data
paths.description: Persistent MediaOps Discord Router request/thread index.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: IANA timezone used by the router.

variables.name: Media Requests Webhook
variables.description: Full Discord Forum webhook URL. Secret: never publish or log it.

variables.name: Webhook Display Name
variables.description: Display name used by the Discord webhook.

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: Optional token for dynamic Forum tag updates. Keep masked and least-privileged.

variables.name: Webhook Auth Header
variables.description: HTTP header used for provider shared-secret authentication. Do not place secrets in URLs.

variables.name: Max Webhook Body Bytes
variables.description: Maximum accepted provider request body size (256 KiB default).

variables.name: Seerr Webhook Auth
variables.description: off, optional, or required. Configure the matching custom header in Seerr before selecting required.

variables.name: Seerr Webhook Token
variables.description: Shared secret expected from Seerr in the configured auth header. Generate a long random value and keep it masked.

variables.name: Ombi Webhook Auth
variables.description: off, optional, or required. Keep off unless Ombi traffic passes through a trusted component that adds the configured header; keep Ombi/router on a private Docker network.

variables.name: Ombi Webhook Token
variables.description: Optional shared secret for authenticated Ombi ingress through a trusted proxy/integration. Never put it in a webhook query string.

variables.name: Router Data Directory
variables.description: Container path for persistent request/thread index.
